# Data use terms

The code is MIT licensed. Data are not: anything derived from Human Connectome Project data
must be handled under that project's terms.

**WU-Minn HCP Open Access Data Use Terms (summary of the points that bind users of this repo)**
1. Do not attempt to identify or contact any subject.
2. Follow your institution's rules, including any IRB or ethics review; this is your institution's decision.
3. Data and derived data may be redistributed only under these same terms.
4. Acknowledge HCP data in any public presentation of results, in the acknowledgments section:
   "Data were provided [in part] by the Human Connectome Project, WU-Minn Consortium (Principal Investigators: David Van Essen and Kamil Ugurbil; 1U54MH091657) funded by the 16 NIH Institutes and Centers that support the NIH Blueprint for Neuroscience Research; and by the McDonnell Center for Systems Neuroscience at Washington University."
5. Cite the relevant HCP methods papers (list: humanconnectome.org/about/acknowledgehcp.html). Do not list the WU-Minn Consortium as an author solely for using the data.
6. Breaking these terms ends access privileges.

**Other datasets.** HCP-Development / Lifespan data and third-party derivatives (for example the
Guo et al. 2025 MSM-HT templates and the Cheng et al. puberty T1w/T2w maps) can carry their own
licences or data-use agreements. Check each source before redistributing anything derived from it.
This archive deliberately ships no HCP-derived data tables.
